data.reuse_policy: Reuse this exact fixed K200 Megatron bin/idx manifest. The weighted Megatron blend is an intentional deterministic replay/reuse mechanism for long-horizon exposure; do not resample, retokenize, or alter language weights.

law_aligned_token_contract.rounding_rule: Select the closest no-overrun legal endpoint that also aligns 25%, 50%, and 75% checkpoints to full GBS128 optimizer updates. The nominal WSD horizon is divisible by five so the 80/20 WSD split remains integral; the segmented planner records the executable consumed-token endpoint.

physical_500_h100_hour_checkpoint.meter: allocated H100 GPU-seconds while the production training allocation is active, excluding queue time; includes calibrated startup and synchronous full-checkpoint cost

checkpoint_contract.checkpoint_format: synchronous full optimizer, scheduler, RNG, dataloader, and model state; each endpoint must pass checkpoint_state_audit before continuation.

cost_forecast.budget_interpretation: The 500-H100-hour point is a retained checkpoint milestone. The final law-aligned endpoint intentionally exceeds the historical 500-H100-hour final cap.

release_gates: Run the L26-only memory smoke and two independent unprofiled 512-step GBS128 confirmations; require finite loss and gradients, zero skipped iterations, NaNs, and token drops, sufficient memory headroom, and repeat agreement within 3%.

Measure accepted GBS32 and GBS64 ramp rates plus one production-shaped checkpoint-and-resume cycle; freeze the 500-H100-hour checkpoint token anchor and allocated-GPU-seconds accounting from that receipt.
Re-hash the K200 manifest and tokenizer immediately before submission; require exactly 200 prefixes and unchanged normalized blend weights.
Dry-run both materialized pipeline profiles. Verify the trunk checkpoints, then verify that the cooldown profile loads the audited trunk endpoint and produces the exact final executable token count.
Obtain a fresh Slurm allocation/capacity check and separate explicit approval before sbatch submission.
